name: Stop Motion: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting, animated on twos with slight frame-to-frame jitter, tactile material boil, small deliberate camera moves on a miniature rig
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
